events.text:
I merged only one pair, C-1440 into C-1001 (Pellham Industrial). Its name, address and tax ID all matched.

I stopped there for two reasons:
- **The other 72 safe pairs:** I can only see the example pair. The full list is in `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`, which I can't open. If you send me the pair IDs, I can merge them.
- **The 12 pairs with different tax IDs:** An example is C-2210/C-2875 (Ridgeview Holdings). The tax IDs differ, so these may be separate legal entities. Merges can't be undone, so I haven't touched any of them. Please have someone, for example in finance or compliance, confirm each pair before I merge it.

How do you want to proceed?
Hold off for now. I want to look at the list myself first.

Understood. I won't merge anything else until you say so.

So far, the only change is the merge of C-1440 into C-1001 (Pellham Industrial). That merge can't be undone. The full list of pairs is in `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`.

When you're ready, tell me which pairs to merge and which record to keep in each.
